overview.en: This report analyzes the performance of various machine learning models on predicting HPR (presumably a variable related to process efficiency or yield) based on a dataset containing several chemical and operational parameters. The winning model is KNN, achieving an R2 score of 0.817 and an RMSE of 0.113.  Other models like RF, XGBoost, SVM, and DT also performed well, but KNN outperformed them significantly. Feature importance analysis reveals that VFA (Volatile Fatty Acids), Butyrate, Acetate, VSS (Volatile Suspended Solids), Propionate, Ethanol, COD-O (Chemical Oxygen Demand), pH, and ORP (Oxidation Reduction Potential) are the most influential features for predicting HPR.  SHAP values and correlation analysis further confirm the importance of these features, highlighting the strong linear relationship between VFA and HPR. The incremental feature table suggests that adding more features beyond the initial set of top performers does not significantly improve model performance. Overall, this report provides valuable insights into the factors influencing HPR and demonstrates the effectiveness of KNN for predicting it.
overview.zh_TW: 本報告分析了各種機器學習模型在預測HPR（假設與流程效率或產量相關的變數）方面的表現，其數據集包含多種化學和操作參數。獲勝模型為KNN，其R2得分達到0.817，RMSE為0.113。RF、XGBoost、SVM和DT等其他模型也表現良好，但KNN的表現明顯優於它們。 特徵重要性分析表明，揮發性脂肪酸（VFA）、丁酸、乙酸鹽、可揮發性懸浮固體（VSS）、丙酸、乙醇、COD-O（化學需氧量）pH和氧化還原電位（ORP）是影響HPR的最關鍵因素。SHAP值和相關分析進一步證實了這些特徵的重要性，突出了VFA與HPR之間的強線性關係。增量特徵表表明，在最初的一組頂級表現者之外添加更多特徵並不能顯著提高模型性能。總體而言，本報告提供了有關影響HPR的因素以及KNN預測其效能的有價值見解。
